  Default: dramatic futuristic digital cityscape at night, neon blue corporate branding elements, premium technology atmosphere

  Same service-aware visual as linkedin but: vibrant neon color palette with gold and cyan accents, portrait composition, explosive dramatic lighting, more artistic and bold, no text no watermark
